disclaimer: Heuristics identify review targets; they do not determine that a page is bad.

metric_notes.asof_present: approximate contract probe (selector OR case-insensitive text pattern); absence is a prompt to look, not a verdict
metric_notes.console_error_count: distinct console 'error' texts across every state of the page the driver attempted, captured or not — a state that failed to load is often the one carrying the evidence
metric_notes.duplicate_heading_texts: case-folded visible heading text seen more than once; a repeated section label across tabs is a legitimate duplicate
metric_notes.panel_count: class-name heuristic over the configured selector list; both over- and under-counts are expected
metric_notes.payload_bytes_total: sum of response body sizes reported by the driver for the reference state; excludes bodies the driver could not size
metric_notes.raw_slug_hits: visible text matching 3+ segment snake_case; legitimate identifiers (file names, API keys quoted on purpose) match too
metric_notes.screenshot_completion: captured states / attempted states for this page; states the registry excludes are not attempted and are recorded as gaps
metric_notes.section_count: direct <section> children of <body> plus direct element children of <main>; an approximation of 'how many blocks is this page'
metric_notes.source_present: approximate contract probe (selector OR case-insensitive text pattern); absence is a prompt to look, not a verdict
metric_notes.visible_word_count: whitespace-split innerText of <body>; Chinese text is not word-segmented, so a zh capture undercounts relative to en
